description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests related to the Leads module in vTiger CRM. It manages actions such as updating lead details and loading related lists, utilizing external dependencies for logging, database access, and CRM entity management.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: CRMEntity class manages CRM module entities and provides method getInstance to retrieve a specific entity object based on the module name.

methods.name: $modObj->retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves entity information for a specific record ID in the Leads module.

methods.name: $modObj->save
methods.description: Saves updates made to a Lead entity in the database.
